description: This file defines a Java interface named CuttlefishControlRunner, which declares methods for executing commands and retrieving file paths related to Cuttlefish control operations in the Android testing environment.

classes.name: CuttlefishControlRunner
classes.description: An interface for controlling and interacting with Cuttlefish instances, providing methods to run commands and access related files.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a command with a specified timeout and returns the result.

methods.name: getHostBinaryPath
methods.description: Retrieves the file path for a host binary given its basename, may throw FileNotFoundException.

methods.name: getHostRuntimePath
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime path for a host binary given its basename, may throw FileNotFoundException.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for the specified path, may throw IOException.
